_comment: 1.5 W1.3 · D 项 RAG 压力评测 prompt 集 — 复用 multipage-1.2 runner
_goal: 让 B.1 双路召回（向量 + amis JSON 关键字）vs 单路向量召回的真实价值可观测
_indicators: 页通过率 / keyword_hits Top-3 命中率 / 失败 case 中 cos_sim 高但 kw=0 的占比
_strategy_note: 推荐跑 r4_baseline（最贴近线上独立 page 模式）；如需横向对比 r1_skeleton 也可加
_dataset_design: 三类样本：A 对抗（描述 vs amis 不一致，向量召回会被描述误导）/ B 混淆（同 type 不同 ui_lib，需 keyword 兜底）/ C 冷启动（新业务类别，向量召回信号弱）

prompts.title: A1 对抗 · 描述说"用户管理"但 amis 是商品价目表
prompts._note: 向量召回会被 extra_prompt 拉去用户管理样本，但 amis JSON 关键字（commodity / price / sku）应纠偏到电商样本
prompts._extra_prompt: 做一个员工用户管理后台，含部门筛选、角色权限、新增编辑

pages.amis_json: {"type":"page","title":"商品列表","body":[{"type":"crud","api":"app://commodity/list","filter":{"controls":[{"name":"category","label":"类目","type":"select","options":["3C","服饰","食品"]},{"name":"priceRange","label":"价格区间","type":"input-range"}]},"columns":[{"name":"sku","label":"SKU"},{"name":"name","label":"商品名"},{"name":"category","label":"类目"},{"name":"price","label":"标价","type":"tpl","tpl":"¥${price}"},{"name":"stock","label":"库存"},{"name":"updatedAt","label":"调价时间","type":"datetime"}]}]}

{"type":"page","title":"价格调整","body":[{"type":"form","api":"app://commodity/price/save","controls":[{"name":"sku","label":"SKU","type":"text","required":true},{"name":"basePrice","label":"标价","type":"input-number","min":0,"required":true},{"name":"promoPrice","label":"促销价","type":"input-number","min":0},{"name":"effectiveFrom","label":"生效时间","type":"input-datetime"}]}]}

{"type":"page","title":"促销活动","body":[{"type":"cards","source":"app://promotion/active","card":{"header":{"title":"${name}"},"body":[{"type":"tpl","tpl":"折扣：${discount}%"},{"type":"tpl","tpl":"覆盖商品：${skuCount}"}],"actions":[{"label":"详情","type":"button","actionType":"link","link":"/promotion/detail"}]}}]}

prompts.title: A2 对抗 · 描述说"OA 请假流程"但 amis 是图文卡片
prompts._note: 向量召回会被描述拉去 oa_form 样本（重表单/校验），但 amis 是 static_page（图文/卡片），关键字 article/banner/markdown 应纠偏
prompts._extra_prompt: 做一个 OA 请假申请流程，含多步表单、审批流转、抄送、撤回

pages.amis_json: {"type":"page","title":"公司新闻","body":[{"type":"banner","image":"https://example.com/banner.jpg","title":"2026 年中庆典"},{"type":"markdown","value":"# 欢迎来到我们的公司\n\n这里有最新的活动公告和团队动态。"},{"type":"cards","source":"app://news/list","card":{"header":{"title":"${title}"},"body":[{"type":"tpl","tpl":"${summary}"},{"type":"tpl","tpl":"发布时间：${publishAt}"}]}}]}

{"type":"page","title":"图文展示","body":[{"type":"grid","columns":[{"body":[{"type":"image","src":"https://example.com/img1.jpg"}]},{"body":[{"type":"image","src":"https://example.com/img2.jpg"}]}]},{"type":"markdown","value":"## 团队风采\n\n我们的团队由资深专家组成。"}]}

{"type":"page","title":"公告详情","body":[{"type":"tpl","tpl":"

${title}

"},{"type":"tpl","tpl":"发布：${author} · ${publishAt}"},{"type":"markdown","value":"${content}"}]}

prompts.title: A3 对抗 · 描述说"销售报表 dashboard"但 amis 是系统设置
prompts._note: 向量会拉到 dashboard 样本（chart/report-forms），但 amis 是 admin_settings（配置项/字典），关键字 config/setting/dict 应纠偏
prompts._extra_prompt: 做一个销售数据 dashboard，含日销量趋势图、Top10 商品报表、客户漏斗分析

pages.amis_json: {"type":"page","title":"系统参数","body":[{"type":"form","api":"app://config/save","controls":[{"name":"systemName","label":"系统名称","type":"text","required":true},{"name":"language","label":"默认语言","type":"select","options":["zh-CN","en-US"]},{"name":"timezone","label":"时区","type":"select","options":["Asia/Shanghai","UTC"]},{"name":"loginRetry","label":"登录重试次数","type":"input-number","min":1,"max":10},{"name":"sessionTimeout","label":"会话超时（分钟）","type":"input-number"}]}]}

{"type":"page","title":"字典维护","body":[{"type":"crud","api":"app://dict/list","filter":{"controls":[{"name":"dictType","label":"字典类型","type":"select","source":"app://dict/types"}]},"columns":[{"name":"code","label":"编码"},{"name":"name","label":"名称"},{"name":"value","label":"值"},{"name":"sortOrder","label":"排序"}],"itemActions":[{"label":"编辑","actionType":"dialog"},{"label":"删除","actionType":"ajax","confirmText":"确认删除？"}]}]}

{"type":"page","title":"权限矩阵","body":[{"type":"crud","api":"app://permission/list","columns":[{"name":"roleName","label":"角色"},{"name":"module","label":"模块"},{"name":"perm","label":"权限","type":"tag"}]}]}

prompts.title: B1 混淆 · select 控件三种来源同页（amis 原生 / element 风格 / ZC 二开）
prompts._note: 同 type:select / department-select / user-select 同时出现，目标看 RAG 能否按 tech_stack=react-antd-vite 优先 amis 原生样本，而不是误抓 zc_business 样本
prompts._extra_prompt: 做一个项目协作工具，要含项目筛选下拉、成员选择、部门归属，使用 amis 原生 select 即可

pages.amis_json: {"type":"page","title":"项目列表","body":[{"type":"crud","api":"app://project/list","filter":{"controls":[{"name":"status","label":"状态","type":"select","options":["草稿","进行中","已归档"]},{"name":"ownerDept","label":"所属部门","type":"department-select"},{"name":"lead","label":"负责人","type":"user-select"}]},"columns":[{"name":"name","label":"项目名"},{"name":"status","label":"状态","type":"status"},{"name":"progress","label":"进度","type":"progress"}]}]}

{"type":"page","title":"任务分配","body":[{"type":"form","api":"app://task/assign","controls":[{"name":"taskTitle","label":"任务","type":"text","required":true},{"name":"priority","label":"优先级","type":"select","options":["高","中","低"],"required":true},{"name":"assignees","label":"指派给","type":"user-select","multiple":true},{"name":"dueDate","label":"截止日期","type":"date"}]}]}

{"type":"page","title":"任务看板","body":[{"type":"grid","columns":[{"body":[{"type":"panel","title":"待办","body":[{"type":"cards","source":"app://task/todo"}]}]},{"body":[{"type":"panel","title":"进行中","body":[{"type":"cards","source":"app://task/wip"}]}]},{"body":[{"type":"panel","title":"已完成","body":[{"type":"cards","source":"app://task/done"}]}]}]}]}

prompts.title: B2 混淆 · 多 date 控件混合（date / datetime / date-range / month）
prompts._note: amis 原生 date 控件四种变体同页出现，目标看 RAG 能否区分日期/日期时间/日期段而非笼统抓 form 样本
prompts._extra_prompt: 做一个考勤打卡分析，含按月汇总、按日明细、自定义时段查询

pages.amis_json: {"type":"page","title":"按月汇总","body":[{"type":"form","controls":[{"name":"month","label":"统计月份","type":"input-month","required":true}]},{"type":"chart","api":"app://attendance/monthly","width":800,"height":400}]}

{"type":"page","title":"按日明细","body":[{"type":"crud","api":"app://attendance/daily","filter":{"controls":[{"name":"date","label":"日期","type":"input-date","required":true},{"name":"empName","label":"员工","type":"text"}]},"columns":[{"name":"empName","label":"员工"},{"name":"checkInTime","label":"上班","type":"datetime"},{"name":"checkOutTime","label":"下班","type":"datetime"},{"name":"duration","label":"工时"}]}]}

{"type":"page","title":"自定义时段","body":[{"type":"form","controls":[{"name":"range","label":"日期范围","type":"input-date-range","required":true},{"name":"precision","label":"精度","type":"select","options":["分钟","小时","天"]}]},{"type":"table","source":"app://attendance/custom"}]}

{"type":"page","title":"加班审批","body":[{"type":"form","api":"app://overtime/apply","controls":[{"name":"startAt","label":"开始","type":"input-datetime","required":true},{"name":"endAt","label":"结束","type":"input-datetime","required":true},{"name":"reason","label":"事由","type":"textarea","required":true}]}]}

prompts.title: B3 混淆 · form 布局多变体（grid / fieldSet / inline / 分组联动）
prompts._note: 同一项目里 form 控件用 4 种布局，看 RAG 是否会笼统抓表单样本而不区分布局策略
prompts._extra_prompt: 做一个 OA 出差申请，要分基本信息、行程、报销三段，并联动控件可见性

pages.amis_json: {"type":"page","title":"出差申请","body":[{"type":"form","api":"app://trip/apply","mode":"horizontal","controls":[{"type":"fieldSet","title":"基本信息","body":[{"name":"empName","label":"申请人","type":"text","required":true},{"name":"dept","label":"部门","type":"department-select","required":true}]},{"type":"fieldSet","title":"行程","body":[{"name":"from","label":"出发","type":"text","required":true},{"name":"to","label":"目的地","type":"text","required":true},{"name":"period","label":"时段","type":"input-date-range","required":true},{"name":"transport","label":"交通","type":"select","options":["飞机","高铁","汽车"]}]},{"type":"fieldSet","title":"报销","visibleOn":"this.transport != null","body":[{"name":"estimateCost","label":"预计金额","type":"input-number","min":0,"required":true},{"name":"reimbursementType","label":"报销方式","type":"radios","options":["垫付","预借"]}]}]}]}

{"type":"page","title":"行程详情","body":[{"type":"form","mode":"inline","controls":[{"name":"tripId","label":"编号","type":"text","disabled":true},{"name":"status","label":"状态","type":"select","disabled":true}]},{"type":"tabs","tabs":[{"title":"行程信息","body":[{"type":"tpl","tpl":"出发：${from} → ${to}"}]},{"title":"审批记录","body":[{"type":"table","source":"app://trip/history"}]}]}]}

prompts.title: C1 冷启动 · 医疗病历（病人档案+病历+处方）
prompts._note: 训练集没医疗领域样本，向量召回信号弱，看双路融合下 keyword（patient/diagnosis/prescription）能不能补
prompts._extra_prompt: 做一个社区诊所的简易病历系统，含病人档案、就诊记录、处方开具

prompts.title: C2 冷启动 · 教育课程（课程列表+选课+成绩）
prompts._note: 教育领域无样本，看 keyword（course/student/grade/enrollment）能否补
prompts._extra_prompt: 做一个学校教务管理系统，含课程开设、学生选课、成绩录入
